sourceText:
Sweet Profiteroles
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 12:00am

Ingredients




1 stk Unsalted butter
1 cup Milk
teaspoon Salt
2 tablespoons Sugar
1 cup Flour
teaspoon Baking powder
5 Eggs

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees. 2 In a medium saucepan heat butter and milk over high heat, whisking until butter melts and mixture comes to a boil. Stir in salt and sugar. Combine flour and baking powder and add to milk mixture all at once, whisking and then stirring until mixture comes away from the sides of pan and forms a ball of dough. Remove from heat and turn into a bowl. 3 Use an electric mixer to beat in 5 eggs, one at a time. Make sure each egg is thoroughly incorporated before adding next. Use a pastry bag without a tip to pipe 16 generous golf ball-size blobs of dough onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake until golden-brown, smooth on the bottom, and dry inside, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool. May be made ahead; do notrefrigerate. 4 This recipe yields 16 pieces.
